P-002: Every derived claim has provenance or declared evidence dependency.
P-003: Unknown/ambiguous does not become false or resolved automatically.
P-005: Missing evidence cannot become observed evidence.
P-006: Local context cannot silently alter unrelated regions.
P-007: One bearer may produce zero, one, or many messages.
P-008: One message may depend on one or many bearers.
P-010: Every implication identifies message/sign evidence it depends on.
